requirements.behavior: Publish only checked personal Linux AppImages from the exact current fork source; update only from this fork's personal channel, preserve app data and credentials, honor Automatic updates, and never restart during recording, processing or stale activity reports.
No reachable OpenWhispr sign-in, subscription, billing, upgrade advertising or managed-cloud onboarding; no unnecessary account-service background requests.
Editable full cleanup/reasoning and transcription model IDs, including unknown suffixes, persist unchanged across discovery, tab switches and reloads; catalogs are not allowlists.

OpenRouter batch transcription is used consistently by dictation, retry and file uploads, even when generic streaming is enabled; never substitute OpenAI models/endpoints; request provider.data_collection=deny.
Nitro, Floor and Exacto are mutually exclusive; Free is offered only for actual catalog variants; full inference IDs are preserved and STT routing limitations remain explicit.
Optional direct Gemini 3.5 batch Smart cleanup, off by default, consistently used by dictation/retry/upload where applicable; no changes to Live mode or other providers.
Preserve recording, hotkeys, paste, history, notes, local models, direct API providers, existing settings, credentials and application user-data identity.
